questions.question: In a one-way ANOVA test comparing 4 distinct treatment groups with 10 subjects per group, the Sum of Squares Between groups (SSB) is calculated as 180, and the Sum of Squares Error (SSE) is calculated as 360. What is the value of the calculated F-statistic?

A manufacturing process produces defective components independently with probability p = 0.20. Let X represent the number of components inspected until the first defective component is found. What is the conditional probability P(X > 5 | X > 2)?

A statistical hypothesis test of H0: mu = 100 against Ha: mu != 100 is conducted at a significance level of alpha = 0.05. If the researcher decides to decrease the significance level to alpha = 0.01 without changing the sample size or the true population parameter, how will the probability of a Type II error (beta) and the statistical power of the test be affected?

A dataset X has a sample mean of 50 and an Interquartile Range (IQR) of 12. A new dataset Y is generated by applying the linear transformation Y = -2X + 5 to each observation. What are the sample mean and the IQR of dataset Y?

Two continuous random variables X and Y have a joint probability density function given by f(x, y) = c(2x + y) for 0 <= x <= 1 and 0 <= y <= 2, and f(x, y) = 0 elsewhere. What is the value of the constant c?
